Jeremie Garcia
admin
10 Nov 2020
0 Comments
Another drug suspect, who was identified as Jeremie Garcia, was killed in Barangay Sapang Palay in the City of San Jose del Monte around 1 a.m. on Sunday after he engaged policemen in a shootout.
The unidentified companions of the suspects managed to escape, police said.
Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: November 6, 2020 Location of Incident: San Jose del Monte, Bulacan
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/11/08/20/2-patay-sa-magkakasunod-na-operasyon-kontra-droga-sa-bulacan https://www.philstar.com/pilipino-star-ngayon/probinsiya/2020/11/08/2055405/2-tulak-todas-sa-bulacan https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1358025/2-drug-suspects-slain-in-bulacan-drug-bust
Sa siyudad naman ng San Jose del Monte, patay rin ang suspek na si Jeremie Garcia alyas Diego, kung saan nakuha naman sa kaniya ang isang pakete ng hinihinalang shabu, isang revolver at motorsiklo.
Arestado rin sa pagkakasangkot sa droga ang 13 iba pa na mula sa mga bayan ng Calumpit, Guiguinto, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Miguel, San Rafael at lungsod ng San Jose Del Monte.

Incident Details
Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: November 6, 2020 Location of Incident: Baliwag, Bulacan
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/11/08/20/2-patay-sa-magkakasunod-na-operasyon-kontra-droga-sa-bulacan https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1358025/2-drug-suspects-slain-in-bulacan-drug-bust https://www.philstar.com/pilipino-star-ngayon/probinsiya/2020/11/08/2055405/2-tulak-todas-sa-bulacan

Blangko pa ang pamilya ng mga biktima sa posibleng motibo sa pamamaril pero dati nang may kaso ang dalawa na may kaugnayan sa droga at ilegal na baril.
Aminado rin si Roylyn Elgarico, asawa ng nasawi at kapatid ng sugatan, na napagbintangang naghagis ng granada ang magbayaw sa Raxabago Police Station.
Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants at home Date of Incident: October 15, 2020 Location of Incident: Manila, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/video/news/10/16/20/gunman-na-naka-suv-lalaki-patay-1-sugatan-sa-pamamaril-sa-tondo https://www.philstar.com/nation/2020/10/17/2050143/2-grenade-throwing-incidents-shot-party
Patay ang isang lalaki matapos paulanan ng bala ang kaniyang bahay sa Brgy. 138, Balut, Tondo, Maynila Huwebes ng gabi.
Pasado alas otso nang pagbabarilin ng mga hindi pa kilalang suspek ang tirahan ni Alfredo Roy Elgarico sa Younger Street, kung saan naroon din ang bayaw niyang si Jay-r Castolome na nasugatan.
Unang binaril umano ng mga gunman si Castolome. Nang tutulungan sana ni Elgarico ang bayaw, binaril din siya ng mga suspek.
Nasa 12 basyo ng 9 mm at kalibre .45 na baril ang narekober sa crime scene.
Sakay ng SUV at may suot na mask at sumbrero ang mga gunman, ayon sa chairman ng Brgy. 138 na si Victor Hepte, Jr.
Blangko pa ang pamilya ng mga biktima sa posibleng motibo sa pamamaril pero dati nang may kaso ang dalawa na may kaugnayan sa droga at ilegal na baril.

Joseph Rey Villegas
admin
07 Nov 2020
0 Comments
The Laguna police provincial police office, Calamba city police station, and other police operatives hatched the buy-bust operation against Villegas along Barangay Road of Barangay Bunggo at 10:10 a.m.
An undercover law enforcer bought shabu worth P1,000 from Villegas, who immediately fired his gun he pulled from his waist after sensing police presence in the area. Lawmen also opened fire, injuring Villegas.
Sex: Male Age: 49 Occupation: Jail Officer
Incident Details
Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: October 29, 2020 Location of Incident: Calamba, Laguna
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/10/30/20/jail-officer-na-nasa-drug-watch-list-ni-duterte-patay-sa-engkuwentro-sa-laguna https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1354251/jail-officer-who-led-a-small-drug-ring-killed-in-laguna-drug-sting
Ayon sa pulisya, si Villegas ang lider ng Villegas drug group na nagtutulak umano ng droga sa Calamba City at maging sa katabing Tanauan City, Batangas.
Isang priority high-value individual sa probinsiya ang suspek at nakatala pa umano sa drug watch list ni Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte.
Dinala pa sa ospital si Villegas pero binawian ito ng buhay. Narekober sa suspek ang 9mm na baril na may marka ng BJMP, mga bala, isang plastik ng bag na may 10 sachet ng umano’y shabu at motorsiklo.
Ayon sa pulis, galing ang ibinebentang shabu ni Villegas.

Namatay on the spot ang biktima habang tumakas patungong Langit Road ang mga salarin.
Isang barangay official malapit sa lugar ang siyang nag-report ng insidente sa Caloocan Police.
Sex: Male Age: 70 Occupation: Army Reservist
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants at home Date of Incident: October 21, 2020 Location of Incident: Caloocan City, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://philnews.ph/2020/10/21/army-reservist-shot-to-death-in-bagong-silang-caloocan-city/ https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/10/21/20/army-reservist-patay-sa-pamamaril-sa-caloocan https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1350790/military-reservist-shot-dead-inside-home-in-caloocan

Kinilala ng mga awtoridad ang biktima bilang si Alfredo Orpeza, na isa ring reservist ng Armed Forces of the Philippines.
Biglang huminto ang riding-in-tandem sa harap ng tindahan ni Orpeza saka siya pinaputukan ng gunman, base sa imbestigasyon.

Joshua Evangelista
admin
05 Nov 2020
0 Comments
Evangelista was among those arrested by police during Oplan Tokhang operations in Caloocan in 2016 on charges of drug possession.
Evangelista died from six gunshots to the body. He also bore bruises, indicating that he was tortured by the suspects, Villanueva said.
Sex: Male Age: 19
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants in public Date of Incident: October 28, 2020 Location of Incident: Caloocan City, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://www.philstar.com/nation/2020/10/23/2051601/teen-shot-dead-caloocan https://twitter.com/raffylerma/status/1321270601617608704 https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=749856092230309&id=432652097284045
A teenager was gunned down by motorcycle-riding assailants in Caloocan City last week.
Joshua Evangelista, 19, spent the last three years of his life in a juvenile jail until he was killed along C-3 Road in Barangay 28.
In a Facebook post, Fr. Flavie Villanueva said Evangelista was described by his family as “helpful, kind” and a “homebuddy” since he was freed from detention in March last year.
Villanueva said his death continued the pattern of shady killings of drug suspects who had been freed from jail.

The killer inscribed other words on the placard with a black pentel pen, but they were rendered unreadable, awash in the dark red of Vincent’s blood.
Age: 27
Incident Details
Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: November 4, 2020 Location of Incident: Angono, Rizal
Source(s)
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/in-depth/vincent-adia-survived-shots-to-head-gunman-kills-him-hospital-rizal https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/regions/762840/shooting-victim-killed-while-undergoing-treatment-at-angono-hospital/story/ https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/in-depth/vincent-adia-angono-rizal-hospital-ejk-victim-last-words
Vincent Adia, 27, was shot thrice in the head at the boundary of Barangay San Isidro and Barangay Mahabang Parang at around 4 am on Wednesday, November 4.
His attempted killer – or killers, as investigators still have no information – left him to die by the gutter, then placed a piece of cardboard that labeled him a “pusher.”
When Adia was reportedly being treated at the hospital, an unidentified suspect barged into the facility and shot him. Based on the initial probe, the gunman was carrying a backpack and wearing black shirt and shorts.

THE Bacolod City Police Station 2 is conducting a thorough investigation in the killing of a 48-year-old drug surrenderer in Purok Sigay, Barangay 2, in Bacolod City Sunday evening, August 30, 2020.
Police identified the fatality as Norman Sola of Barangay 2.

The police are also coordinating with the family of the victim.

Paala, who got out of the city jail just three months ago after serving time for drug charges, was shot dead by motorcycle-riding assailants at the corner of Mabilis and Maunawin Streets at his village—the spot where he used to sell balut, or fermented duck eggs, every day.
Sex: Male Age: 46 Occupation: Balut Vendor
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants in public Date of Incident: July 20, 2020 Location of Incident: Quezon City, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://mb.com.ph/2020/07/21/balut-vendor-shot-to-death-by-unknown-gunmen/ https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/07/21/20/activist-priest-kinondena-ang-patuloy-na-patayan-sa-gitna-ng-pandemya https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1327020/ejks-in-a-time-of-pandemic-qc-village-grapples-with-a-deadlier-virus
A balut vendor recently released from jail over drug charges was shot to death by several gunmen in Quezon City on Monday night (July 20).
The victim was identified as Gilbert Paala, 46.
Witnesses said that Paala was selling balut at his makeshift stall on Mabilis St. in Barangay Piñahan around 8 p.m. when three men aboard a motorcycle peppered him with bullets.
They said they heard at least three gunshots.

Unidentified motorcycle-riding gunmen shot dead a newly-assumed barangay councilor in front of his daughter here Monday morning.

Mamalinta said the victim was about to board his vehicle when two masked suspects riding in tandem on a motorcycle approached and shot him several times.
